ja402:1.1: Vibbhantacitto kupitindriyo si, nettehi te vārigaṇā savanti, kin te naṭṭhaṃ kiṃ pana patthayāno idhāgamā brahme tad iṃgha brūhīti.
ja402:2.1: Mīyetha bhariyā vajato mam' ajja, agacchato maraṇaṃ āha yakkho, etena dukkhena pavedhito 'smi, akkhāhi me Senaka etam atthan ti.
ja402:3.1: Bahūni ṭhānāni vicintayitvā yam ettha vakkhāmi tad eva saccaṃ, maññāmi te brāhmaṇa sattubhastaṃ ajānato kaṇhasappo paviṭṭho ti.
ja402:4.1: Ādāya daṇḍaṃ parisumbha bhastaṃ, pass' eḷamūgaṃ uragaṃ dijivhaṃ, chind' ajja kaṃkhaṃ vicikicchitāni, bhujaṅgamaṃ passa, pamuñca bhastan ti.
ja402:5.1: Saṃviggarūpo parisāya majjhe so brāhmaṇo sattubhastaṃ pamuñci, atha nikkhami urago uggatejo āsīviso sappo phaṇaṃ karitvā ti.
ja402:6.1: Suladdhalābhā Janakassa rañño yo passatī Senakaṃ sādhupaññan ti. imāni me sattasatāni
ja402:7.1: atthi, gaṇhāhi sabbāni dadāmi tuyhaṃ. Tayā hi me jīvitaṃ ajja laddhaṃ, atho pi bhariyāya-m-akāsi sotthin ti.
ja402:8.1: Na paṇḍitā vedanam ādiyanti citrāhi gāthāhi subhāsitāhi, ito pi te brahme dadantu vittaṃ, ādāya tvaṃ gaccha sakaṃ niketan ti.
